_provenance.how: Built by instantiating the SDK's own pydantic models (openai.types.beta.threads.Run / RunStep / Message, openai.types.responses.Response) and serialising with model_dump(mode='json'). Pydantic validated every required field, Literal discriminator, and discriminated-union member, so the shape is the vendor's, not the author's.
_provenance.no_model_calls: No OpenAI model was called and no API key is needed. Only the type layer ran, so this fixture adds no vendor dependency to the tests.
_provenance.field_values_are_authored: The SHAPE is the vendor's; the VALUES (ids, text, timings) are authored to make a coherent scenario, exactly as the openai_agents_handoff_trace.json fixture does.
_provenance.scenario: The same refund, via the Responses API. Output items cover reasoning, function_call, function_call_output (a gateway-timeout error payload) and message; the response itself ends `failed` with a top-level error.
